_comment: The Codex CLI that io ships: the release *package* tarball for each target (bin/codex, bin/codex-code-mode-host, codex-path/rg, codex-resources/{bwrap,zsh}), the same tree the npm package installs. The bare codex binary alone is not enough: since 0.154 commands run through codex-code-mode-host and Codex fails closed without it (seen on the x64 laptop 2026-09-14). Checked against these hashes before unpacking. Bump deliberately: the proxy in service.py was verified against exactly this version's wire behaviour (chronology 2026-09-14).
